Package neqsim.process.engineering.safety

Class SafetyVerificationBenchmarkSuite

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.engineering.safety.SafetyVerificationBenchmarkSuite
public final class SafetyVerificationBenchmarkSuite extends Object
Versioned safety verification benchmarks backed by NeqSim's production-readiness benchmark model.

Expected values and their provenance are supplied externally. A suite qualifies only when every required method passes and the caller declares a non-regression source plus an independent review record. The class does not assert that those declarations are true; document control and accountable reviewers remain responsible for them.

    • SafetyVerificationBenchmarkSuite

      public SafetyVerificationBenchmarkSuite(String suiteId, String suiteRevision, EngineeringValidationBenchmark.SourceClass sourceClass, String sourceReference, String datasetRevision, String independentReviewRecord)
      Creates a three-method safety benchmark suite.
      Parameters:
      suiteId - controlled benchmark-suite identifier
      suiteRevision - suite revision
      sourceClass - provenance class for the externally supplied expected values
      sourceReference - controlled reference to the independent calculation or published case
      datasetRevision - source dataset revision
      independentReviewRecord - controlled independent-review record, or blank for non-qualifying evidence
